# umami-mcp

> MCP server aligned with the public Umami Analytics v3.3.1 contracts.

## Configuration

Self-hosted: set UMAMI_URL, UMAMI_USERNAME, and UMAMI_PASSWORD.
Cloud: set UMAMI_API_KEY; the API base defaults to https://api.umami.is/v1.
UMAMI_COLLECTOR_URL optionally overrides the public collection/share/heartbeat/recorder host.

## Contract rules

- Cloud management paths strip the self-hosted /api prefix.
- send_event uses type=event for both named events and pageviews; omit name for a pageview.
- batch_events sends a raw JSON array (1-500 items), without authentication;
  it returns per-item error details and marks partial failures as MCP errors.
- Collector requests include the User-Agent header required by Umami;
  visitor userAgent/ip can also be supplied in event payloads.
- Public send, batch, heartbeat, share-by-slug, and recorder-config routes do not require credentials.
- Analytics uses path instead of the removed url filter/metric, and hostname instead of host.
- Units: minute, hour, day, month, year. Do not use week.
- get_event_series and get_sessions_weekly require an IANA timezone.
- list_reports requires websiteId. run_report sends websiteId, type, filters, and parameters.
- Current report types: attribution, breakdown, funnel, goal, heatmap, journey, performance, retention, revenue, utm.
- Move a website to a user or team with transfer_website. Removed team-website mutation endpoints are not tools.
- A self-hosted 2FA login must be completed with complete_two_factor_login before retrying the original tool.
- Cloud API keys cannot call /me/password, /users, or /users/*.

## Major tool groups

- Websites and analytics: website CRUD, stats, pageviews, metrics, event/session lists, values, realtime
- Collection: event/pageview, identify, performance, batch, link/pixel event
- Reports: saved report CRUD and all current documented report types
- Boards, tracked links, tracking pixels
- Segments and cohorts
- Session replay and recorder configuration
- Managed/public shares and website CSV ZIP export
- Revenue stats, charts, metrics, sessions
- Users, teams, website user/team transfer
- Self-hosted 2FA setup and enforcement

Use MCP tools/list for the complete tool list and JSON schemas.
